steps: Proof yeast in warm water (105-110F) with sugar for 5-8 minutes. At 9,000 ft yeast activates quickly — don't let it over-foam.
Combine flour and salt in COOK-04 bowl with dough hook. Add yeast mixture and softened butter.
Mix on low 2 minutes, then medium 6-8 minutes until smooth and slightly tacky.
Shape into a ball. Place in a lightly oiled bowl. Cover.
First proof in COOK-01 Proof mode 45-55 minutes until just doubled. Watch closely — altitude rises 20-30% faster. Punch down before it over-rises.
Shape into a loaf and place in a greased 9x5 pan. Second proof in COOK-01 Proof mode 30-40 minutes. Don't let it crest the pan edge.
Preheat COOK-01 lower oven to 375F. ProBake Convection handles heat distribution — no adjustment needed for metal pan.
Bake 25-30 minutes until deep golden and hollow when tapped. Pull at 190F internal on probe.
Cool on rack 20 minutes before slicing.
